_note: Every vendor id the site reports to, in one file. Nothing here is a secret: these are public, client-side ids that ship in the page either way. A blank id disables that vendor on every lane, which is how a fork of this repo runs the site without reporting into our accounts.
_affonso: The affiliate programme. `?via=<code>` on any inbound link is the referral, and it is already carried through every CTA on the site. Set the programme id to switch attribution on.
